# 1800 rows sampled with seed 1 by sources/build-corpus.mjs (50 adjective, superlative, 70 adjective, comparative, 180 adjective, declined, 100 noun, dative plural, 220 noun, plural, 120 noun, genitive, 30 noun, other singular, 150 verb, separated, 160 verb, participle, 60 verb, zu-infinitive, 80 verb, imperative, 160 verb, subjunctive, 200 verb, past, 220 verb, present); a separated particle's row ends with a full stop (rufe an.), a superlative's row is the adjective without am (schönsten).
